class.name: rviz_plugins/TopicHealthPanel
class.description: Table of per-topic rate and staleness from health_check.

class.name: rviz_plugins/ArenaMinimapPanel
class.description: Top-down 2D minimap of the Lunabotics arena: zone rectangles drawn from a local copy of arena_layout.json, plus an arrow for the rover pose. Needs no map, costmap or mesh from the robot - only /arena/robot_pose.

class.name: rviz_plugins/MobilityEfficiencyPanel
class.description: Linear and angular mobility efficiency from the mobility watchdog, as two bars coloured red through amber to green, with amber landing on the slip threshold. Greys a channel that has nothing commanded to measure.

class.name: rviz_plugins/MissionControlPanel
class.description: Configures, starts and stops a mission on mission_bt_server: full autonomy (drive + bucket step at each zone) or navigation only, zone waypoints picked on the map or chosen by arena_server, and a number of cycles.

class.name: rviz_plugins/ExcavationPoint
class.description: Click and drag, like 2D Goal Pose, to set the Mission Control panel's excavation waypoint. Publishes on /mission/excavation_point.

class.name: rviz_plugins/ConstructionPoint
class.description: Click and drag, like 2D Goal Pose, to set the Mission Control panel's construction waypoint. Publishes on /mission/construction_point.

class.name: rviz_plugins/ViewLockPanel
class.description: One checkbox in place of the Views panel: ticked, the camera switches to a saved view from the config ("Far" by default) and is held there; unticked, it moves freely.

class.name: rviz_plugins/MachineHealthPanel
class.description: Table of CPU, memory and temperature for every machine publishing /<device_name>/system_health, found automatically.
